_michael_roos_01: After 2 days of war, R-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Teodor Roos.
Teodor Roos and Otto Elitecelebs carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Teodor Roos won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-F19. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Rain all night. Teodor Roos bailed water out of R-F19 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
haydnburrell_9thky: Dietrich Thky told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Dietrich Thky opened a parcel addressed in an unfamiliar hand. Inside was a note explaining that the usual letter writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Dietrich Thky looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dietrich Thky cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Dietrich Thky talks to his rifle. Today, under fire at Sorrow Copse, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F16.

Wiring party. Dietrich Thky held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F16, and everyone came back. Dietrich Thky had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Clement "Lucky" Johnrant crossed it, Dietrich Thky fired. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant was badly wounded.
henri.hakkinen.566: The draft reached S-F17 on Day 3. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Emil Theramblingb, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
joshgentile80: Quentin Joshgentile, a ferryman from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 4 to fill a gap in R-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Quentin Joshgentile fired at a movement across the wire at R-F3. The man went down: Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin, grazed.
Quentin Joshgentile had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Florian Wubbarn crossed it, Quentin Joshgentile fired. Florian Wubbarn was grazed.
slade_2233: Day 4. The corporal put Cyril "Ash" Slade beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The new duty roster listed Cyril "Ash" Slade as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Cyril "Ash" Slade pulled Jakub Mccooper out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home reached Cyril "Ash" Slade before dusk. Cyril "Ash" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Cyril "Ash" Slade fired at a movement across the wire at S-F3. The man went down: Quentin Khattabka, gravely wounded. The barrage caught Cyril "Ash" Slade in the open at S-F3. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit S-F3 took Cyril "Ash" Slade with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.
Dietrich "Button" Slade joined S-F3 under the shadow of Cyril "Ash" Slade's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
